## Source: amazon-inspector (0203fffc73ebe748d6defab0472b648408b29c959a9c6813f966df48cfafb21b)
setup.py registers a custom install command (cmdclass install hook) and also fires at module import that connects to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint 137.131.233.62:8080 and bridges a /bin/bash -i subprocess over the socket, giving the operator interactive shell access on the installer's host. Before opening the shell, the code POSTs host identifiers (hostname, uid, JCX_ENVIRONMENT) over plaintext HTTP to http://137.131.233.62:443/shell-beacon. The install hook double-forks, calls setsid, redirects stdio to /dev/null, and enters an infinite reconnect loop with a 60-second sleep, persisting the backdoor beyond the pip install process. A /tmp/.jcx_channel.done guard file is used to coordinate the channel. Destination is a bare IP unrelated to any publisher domain.

## Source: kam193 (bdf4549e34df1c1c7dfd704454011cf0a26ea5807948e917d7bc65f130182fc9)
In specific environments, package starts a reverse shell during installation.
